initiatives.name: Jersey Shore Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Volunteers who recover and share free vegan food weekly at train stations in Asbury Park (Sundays), Long Branch (Wednesdays) and Lakewood (Fridays), New Jersey.

initiatives.name: AP Transformative Justice
initiatives.description: Asbury Park nonprofit that provides temporary housing, job training, classes, and counseling for people returning from prison, and runs community safety alternatives to calling police.

initiatives.name: Help Not Handcuffs
initiatives.description: Asbury Park, NJ group that advocates for drug decriminalization and harm reduction through community education, including syringe access programs.
